title: CertMaster CSC Part 1 Embedded Question Bank Schema v2
description: Canonical JSON schema accepted by com.example.data.EmbeddedExamBank.parseWithMetadata for offline standalone CSC Part 1 APK builds.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version supported by EmbeddedExamBank (use 2 for new banks).

examId.description: Must match BuildConfig.TARGET_EXAM_ID ('csc-part-1'). Loader fails closed on mismatch.

bankVersion.description: Semantic or date-based version identifier persisted with session and mastery records (e.g. '2026.1').

syllabusEdition.description: Authoritative CSI CSC Volume 1 curriculum/textbook edition string verified by the content author (do not invent).

syllabusWeights.description: Optional verified CSI domain exam weights keyed by verified domainId. Positive integers summing to ~100.

simulationPapers.description: Optional ordered timed full-exam simulations referencing unique question IDs defined in questions[].

id.description: Globally unique, stable ID within csc-part-1 (never reuse or mutate across bank revisions).

domainId.description: Stable app-owned domain identifier mapped to a verified CSC Volume 1 curriculum heading. Do not claim it is an official CSI-issued code unless the source provides one.

domainName.description: Human-readable CSC Volume 1 domain title matching domainId.

topicId.description: Stable app-owned topic identifier, unique across this bank and mapped to a verified topic inside domainId. Keep published IDs unchanged.

topicName.description: Human-readable topic title matching topicId. Recommended required for v2.

objectiveId.description: Stable app-owned learning-objective identifier mapped to a verified objective. Official CSI-issued codes are optional; do not invent official codes.

learningObjective.description: Human-readable syllabus learning objective text tested by this item.

questionType.description: Single-best-answer question format accepted by EmbeddedExamBank.parseWithMetadata.

questionPool.description: Controls pool eligibility. FULL_EXAM_RESERVED is excluded from Initial Assessment and Adaptive Practice.

nearDuplicateGroupId.description: Shared group ID for items testing the exact same stem/concept variant so the engine avoids back-to-back near-duplicates.

difficulty.description: Explicit difficulty label; omit when uncalibrated (engine uses neutral weight when omitted).

correctIndex.description: Zero-based index into options array (0 <= correctIndex < options.length).

explanation.description: Comprehensive rationale explaining why the correct answer is right.

optionAnalysis.description: Per-option rationale keyed by zero-based index ('0','1','2','3') or option letter ('A','B','C','D'). Shown immediately in adaptive practice.

diagnosticQuestionIds.description: Optional ordered diagnostic IDs. Every ID must exist and must not be FULL_EXAM_RESERVED. When present, Initial Assessment uses this exact complete sequence, including on retake.
